messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered — service=cat-service severity=critical. symptoms=spike in model-config errors + tokenization exceptions. suspected component=model-catalog. page_key=PD-98765.

pagerduty: PD alert: cat-service (model-config) — unacked by eng-oncall. Please acknowledge.

emma: acked. I'm on it. seeing error rates jump in api-proxy logs, 502s with 'tokenizer mismatch' on requests routed to model=gpt-13b-variant.

raj: +1, looking at catalog DB stream. I see a fast-forwarded revision for gpt-13b: revision rev-2026-b was promoted ~5m ago and has tokenizer=sentencepiece-v2 while runtime expects byte-level-bpe. That would explain the tokenization exceptions.

mike: Ugh, autopromote job must've run. There's a promo job trace: job/auto-promote-322 completed 4m ago. It promoted rev-2026-b without matching tokenizer metadata.

emma: Confirming client errors: lots of evals failing with "tokenize failed: unknown token id" and some request OOMs because token boundaries differ. Customer-facing 5xxs up ~6%.

luis: Paging severity? Do we treat as S3 (partial customer impact) or S2?

emma: Marking S2 for now — visible errors for some routes and increased latency for chat endpoints. Not full outage but customer impact.

raj: Runbook step 1: rollback routing to previous stable revision (rev-2026-a). I'm patching route to pin to rev-2026-a and turning off autopromote for gpt-13b.

mike: Command I'm running now:
```bash
# pin route to previous revision
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  https://console.internal/v1/catalog/routes/gpt-13b/pin \ 
  -d '{"revision":"rev-2026-a"}'
```

ops-bot: Route pin request accepted — route/gpt-13b pinned to rev-2026-a. Autoscaling unaffected.

emma: Good. Rolling traffic back looks green for most prod lanes. Error rate falling — from 6% to 1.2% in 10m window.

raj: Also disabling autopromote job and adding a safety check on tokenizer metadata in promo pipeline. Opening PR: #5123.

mike: Will run quick smoke tests against pinned revision. Running local tokenization check for a few edge prompts.

sara: Notified affected customers with an initial heads-up: "We're investigating elevated errors on certain endpoints; mitigation in progress." Will post update after rollback stabilizes.

luis: Who will own postmortem and communication? I can take incident lead for follow-through.

emma: I'll hand off operational follow-ups to luis. Raj please keep the catalog fix as action item owner. Mike, follow up on bake/test gaps in promo pipeline. Sara will coordinate customer comms and collecting impacted customers.

raj: Noted. root cause preliminary: a model revision was promoted without matching tokenizer metadata validation. Fix path = add validation + backfill missing tokenizer field for rev-2026-b OR revoke rev from catalog until repack happens.

mike: Suggestion: decompose promo pipeline: require a successful 'tokenizer compatibility' smoke test that runs tokenization+detokenization roundtrip on representative inputs. If it fails, block rollouts. I'll prototype test harness.

ops-bot: pagerduty note: PD-98765 acknowledged by emma at 2790012358.

emma: Logging closure criteria: (1) error rate <=0.5% for 30m, (2) pinned route in place and autopromote disabled, (3) PR for fix created, (4) customer update sent. Current status: error rate 0.7% and trending down.

luis: If stable in 30m we can resolve. I'll schedule the handoff to next oncall in 40m.

raj: Created PR #5123 and added unit + integration test for tokenizer header match. Also queued a rollback/rebuild for rev-2026-b to correct packaging.

sara: Sent second customer update: "We've pinned traffic to the previous revision; errors are returning to baseline. Full root cause and remediation steps will follow."

emma: We're good to de-escalate monitoring but keep an eye on any anomaly windows. Oncall handoff in 40m to luis.

luis: Acknowledged. I'll be on hand for the handoff and follow-up postmortem write-up. Thanks team :heart: 

incident-bot: Incident flagged resolved -> mitigation in place. Please file postmortem template under /incidents with tag=catalog-tokenizer-mismatch.

emma: filing now. Closing PD incident after handoff.

-- end thread --
